The second RESQUE consultation hours will take place on **June 17, 2026, from 09:00 to 10:00**.

Join us to discuss questions and challenges related to responsible research assessment and to learn more about applying the RESQUE framework in practice. We will also highlight specific topics such as applying RESQUE in clinical psychology with the clinical expansion pack. Questions and comments from all disciplines as well as from interested appointment committees are welcome.
